title: Inside the Chinese Boom in Corporate Espionage - Bloomberg
主要内容: The article discusses the growing issue of corporate espionage in China, highlighting a case involving American Superconductor Corp. (AMSC), a U.S.-based company that develops computer systems for wind turbines. In June 2011, AMSC technicians were sent to a wind farm in China’s Gobi Desert to investigate a malfunction in a turbine manufactured by Sinovel Wind Group, AMSC’s largest customer. The technicians entered the turbine’s main shaft, climbed 230 feet to the nacelle, and discovered that the turbine continued to operate despite a shutdown command issued by AMSC’s new control system software. This incident raised concerns about potential security breaches or sabotage, underscoring the risks of corporate espionage in the global renewable energy sector.
